rows.en: ???: "Hey, Mom! Hurry up!"
???: "If you get too excited, you'll fall."
???: "I'll be fine... Eek!"
???: "There, you see?"
???: "Eheh heh heh."
???: "Are you all right? Are you hurt?"
???: "Yeah... Huh? Hey, Mom.
Someone's lying over there."
???: "We have to help!"
???: "This is... a sword wound."
???: "That's awful... Who would do this...
Mom, is he dead...?"
???: "His pulse..."
Oswald: "Ugh... P-Princess..."
???: "!! He's alive! He's still alive!"
???: "Yes! Kururu, go and get someone!"
Kururu: "Okay!"
Celica: "We'll be at the Holy Land soon."
Don't ask about the Holy Land
Ask about the Holy Land
Arthur: "Come to think of it, the Holy Land is a sanctuary
protected by a nonaggression agreement, isn't it?"
Celica: "Yes. Even the Kingdom of Agarthia
left the Holy Land alone."
Touya: "There's something I want to ask.
What exactly is this 'Holy Land'?"
Celica: "Huh? Nobody told you?
Hmm... Ymir, could you explain?"
Ymir: "Hm? Explain the Holy Land? ...Well... To put it simply,
it's the collective name for the institutions in this world of Agarthia
that train Alchemists and conduct research. Do you understand?"
Touya: "Not at all."
Ymir: "Well, the people called 'scientists' in your world
are called 'Alchemists'
here.
It is their center of learning,
research and craftsmanship, all in one.
It was originally established to discourage the misuse of Alchemy
and promote 'cooperation for the sound advancement of technology.'
It is free from the influence of any national government,
an inviolable sanctuary where every nation is forbidden to use armed force.
That is the 'Holy Land.'"
Touya: "Huh. Then why is it inside the territory
of the Kingdom of Agarthia?"
Ymir: "It wasn't originally that way.
As the Kingdom of Agarthia expanded its territory,
the situation came to be as it is now.
You could even call it the smallest independent nation
on the continent."
Touya: "There must be some reason why a place like that
gets to be an inviolable sanctuary, right?"
Celica: "Oh, you're surprisingly sharp."
Touya: "You can leave out the 'surprisingly.'"
Celica: "Ha ha ha! Sorry, sorry.
Well, the Holy Land also does
the most advanced research on Armored Mech development.
In other words, bringing it under your country's control would mean
getting every bit of technology used to build Armored Mechs. If you wanted
to unite the world by force, it would be the perfect target."
Touya: "Then all the more reason to... Oh."
Celica: "Exactly. You don't think the surrounding countries would just stand by
and let that happen, do you? They kept each other in check, eventually made an agreement,
and that became the principle of 'nonaggression.'"
Fain: "Besides, the Holy Land has Rayblade.
If the Holy Land's in danger, it'll go FLASH,
then come bursting out with a BOOM! I'm sure of it."
Touya: "'You're sure'...? So you're just guessing.
Hm? ...Speaking of which, what's this Rayblade?"
Celica: "It's the machine that served as the basis
for the Spirit Mechs you pilot. Well, since it was discovered 29 years ago,
it hasn't moved even once, but there are records of it
facing Ze=Ode all by itself 109 years ago.
That's why people say its power is equal to Ze=Ode's,
or perhaps even greater."
Touya: "But if it won't move, then what's the point...?"
Celica: "Well, yeah. And it's been sealed away,
so now we can't even examine it.
We were really lucky to get the data before that happened."
Touya: "...What do you mean?"
Celica: "Heh heh heh. It's a secret."
Touya: "You..."
Ymir: "Celica hacked in and obtained it."
Arthur: "What?! Is that what happened?"
Celica: "Huh? Didn't I tell you?"
Ymir: "It should have been a major scandal, but by the time we realized,
she'd already made us accomplices... Who could have imagined
that the data had been used in the prototypes?"
Celica: "But if I hadn't done that,
they still wouldn't be finished even now."
Ymir: "That may be true, but...
Do you know how much trouble Lady Ivel and Prince Lodis
had to go through because of it...?"
Touya: "...Some princess you are."
Celica: "Eheh heh heh heh."
Fain: "Come to think of it, you said the Holy Land had new Spirit Mechs,
didn't you?"
Ymir: "Yes. Dusseldorf, a close-combat Spirit Mech,
and Forstin, an aerial-support model, should have finished
their adjustments by now..."
Fain: "The princess showed me footage of it before.
That machine called Dusseldorf is complete, isn't it?"
Celica: "Of course. It should be ready to move right now."
Fain: "I see... Right now... Heh heh heh heh."
Celica: "Hey, Fain?
You're not thinking of anything strange, are you?!"
Fain: "O-of course not! The thought of getting in at the first opportunity
has not crossed my mind in the slightest!"
Touya: "..."
Touya: "What...? The crystal... Is it ringing...?"
Ymir: "Hm? Is something wrong?"
Touya: "Huh? You can't hear it?"
Celica: "What is it? What can you hear?"
Touya: "It's this..."
Touya: "Oh, it stopped..."
Ai: "That's... what Alforina gave you..."
Ymir: "The Resonance Crystal... Why do you have that?"
Touya: "Oh, right. You'd stepped away then, hadn't you?
Queen Alforina gave it to me, saying
it would lead us in the right direction.
I meant to give it back properly, but then that happened..."
Ymir: "I-I see... Could Lady Alforina have
foreseen what would happen...?"
Ai: "...Maybe... She did say that, though they were vague,
she had the ability to see prophetic dreams...
But if that's true, why...?"
Arthur: "That's the kind of person she was, wasn't she?
She would try to save as many other people as possible rather than herself...
You know that better than anyone, don't you, Ai?"
Ai: "I do, but... Still..."
Clovis: "Does that crystal have some kind
of special significance?"
Ymir: "This... The Resonance Crystal is the key
to undoing the seal currently placed on Rayblade."
Arthur: "I see. Without obtaining that crystal,
no one can undo Rayblade's seal.
And Rayblade is in the Holy Land, while the key is in York..."
Touya: "Why go to all that trouble?"
Arthur: "That means they had no intention
of using Rayblade, correct?"
Ymir: "Yes. Keeping them apart meant no one could lay a hand on it.
Furthermore, the Istarsh royal family has strong ties to the Holy Land,
and both the previous queen and Queen Alforina were people
we could trust.
That is why we asked for their cooperation
when placing the seal. In other words, York also had
another duty: to serve as Rayblade's guardian."
Touya: "Is Rayblade really that dangerous?"
Ymir: "Rayblade itself is not dangerous.
But we don't know the full extent of its power, and to protect it
from those who would exploit it, we surrounded it
with a Frail Barrier, which absorbs Prana emissions,
and sealed it away. Even so, there is still no end to the people
trying to obtain information on Rayblade..."
Miyasco: "We're almost at the Holy Land. ...Ah!"
Ymir: "What's wrong?"
Miyasco: "The Holy Land... The Holy Land is under attack!"
Celica: "What?! Which country is it?!
Are they trying to make enemies of the whole world?!"
Miyasco: "W-well..."
Clovis: "Hey, hey. You're being pretty slow about this."
Miyasco: "I-I'm sorry..."
Derock: "It can't be helped, you know. Her usual job
is communications, you know. We're short-handed, you know.
If you're going to grumble, do it yourself, you know."
Clovis: "Wh... What did you say?!"
Ymir: "H-hey!
This is no time for that!"
Miyasco: "Oh, I've got it... Huh? This is...
There's no matching data!"
Celica: "...Does that mean it's some country's new model?"
Touya: "Anyway, we can't just stand by and watch, right?
Let's go help them!"
Arthur: "Agreed. Let's hurry and prepare to launch!"
Celica: "Oh, I'm sure you already know,
but you're staying on standby this time too."
Fain: "Yes, I understand perfectly. Heh heh heh heh."
Celica: "...You don't understand at all."

review_batches.context: Examined all 178 s_007 rows, all 137 s_006 rows, s_005 rows 118..129 and s_008 rows 0..79. Kururu and her mother find wounded Oswald. After a scene change, optional Holy Land questions explain its neutrality, research role, surrounding kingdom and Rayblade's recorded history.
review_batches.decisions: Keep both mother and child labeled ??? until the source reveals Kururu's label; do not reveal the mother's name early. Oswald's Princess address stays as spoken. Preserve both menu options and the distinction between Agarthia the world and the Kingdom of Agarthia. Holy Land is a collective institutional designation and protected sanctuary. Rayblade's strength is reported, not measured; retain discovery 29 years ago and combat record 109 years ago as separate dates. Fain's dramatic activation claim is explicitly speculation.

review_batches.context: Examined all s_006/s_007 rows and the stated adjacent slices (407 total). Celica reveals how Rayblade data entered the prototypes; Fain eyes Dusseldorf. The crystal rings for Touya alone, prompting discussion of Alforina's dreams and the seal's key. The Holy Land then comes under attack.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve the theft/hacking revelation without adding procedural details. New-machine readiness remains qualified as Ymir's expectation. Alforina's foresight is a possibility discussed by characters, not confirmed omniscience or a stated choice to die. Preserve the crystal/key, geographic separation, royal family's guardianship and Prana-absorbing Frail Barrier. Rayblade itself is explicitly said not to be dangerous. Miyasco's new report does not yet identify the attackers.

review_batches.context: Examined all s_006/s_007 rows and adjacent slices, 407 total. Miyasco struggles with unfamiliar duties; Derock defends her and challenges Clovis. The party prepares to help the Holy Land, while Celica reiterates Fain's standby order and doubts his compliance.
review_batches.decisions: Miyasco is female and normally handles communications, confirmed by her glossary profile and Derock's explicit words. Render Derock's repeated nandana ending with you know to retain his matter-of-fact, irritating speech rhythm. Do not invent a nationality for unidentified new models. Keep Fain's suspicious laugh and Celica's disbelief; do not announce what he will do in battle. This is the 18-row final slice.
